deep.reconstruction: This is the title page of a handwritten copy (fair copy or draft) of Riemann's doctoral dissertation. It has no mathematics. The text reads: 'Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe. Inaugural-Dissertation von B. Riemann. Göttingen 1851.' In English: 'Foundations for a general theory of functions of a variable complex quantity.' The dissertation was submitted to Göttingen in November 1851 and defended in December 1851, with Gauss as the referee. It introduces the Cauchy–Riemann equations as the defining property of complex functions, Riemann surfaces, the Dirichlet principle and the Riemann mapping theorem. None of this content appears on this page. There are no derivations to reconstruct.
